title.en: Shared responsive wordmark and clean footer
title.zh: 页眉页脚共用响应式品牌字标并清理页脚

purpose.en: Keep the SmartLingo brand readable when desktop navigation uses two rows, reuse the same segmented wordmark in the footer, and remove the redundant footer language switcher.
purpose.zh: 当桌面导航使用两行时保持 SmartLingo 品牌清晰可读，让页脚复用同一分段字标，并移除重复的页脚语言切换。

en: Wrap the brand only between Smart and Lingo in the two-row desktop range.
Place the active-language text button before the account icon.
Use a standard solid dropdown chevron and keep language switching in the header and hamburger menu only.
zh: 在桌面两行范围内只允许在 Smart 与 Lingo 之间换行。
将当前语言文字按钮固定在用户图标之前。
使用标准实心下拉箭头，并仅在页眉和汉堡菜单中保留语言切换。

en: Add a reusable segmented SmartLingo wordmark.
Move the language menu before the account icon and replace the hollow chevron with a solid chevron.
Remove the footer language selector and repeated product links; keep About, Privacy, Terms, and Project in that order.
zh: 新增可复用的分段 SmartLingo 字标。
将语言菜单移到用户图标之前，并把空心箭头替换为实心箭头。
移除页脚语言选择器与重复产品链接，并按顺序只保留 About、Privacy、Terms、Project。

en: Run the complete repository test suite, type check, production build, and shared-site policy gates.
Verify the segmented two-line header wordmark at the affected desktop width in production Chrome.
Verify the footer reuses the header wordmark and contains no language switcher.
zh: 运行完整仓库测试、类型检查、正式构建及共享站点政策门禁。
在正式站 Chrome 的受影响桌面宽度核验分段双行页眉字标。
核验页脚复用页眉字标且不再包含语言切换。

en: No learning, billing, referral, certificate, challenge, or leaderboard behavior changes in this release.
zh: 本次发布不改变学习、支付、推荐、证书、挑战或排行榜行为。

en: SmartLingo keeps the exact same green Lingo segment and S icon in both header and footer while adopting the global wordmark and footer-language rules.
zh: SmartLingo 在采用全局字标与页脚语言规则时，让页眉和页脚保留完全相同的绿色 Lingo 分段和 S 图标。
